scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix cobo && npm install --prefix server
scripts.test:ai: cd server && node --import tsx ../tests/botBrain.test.ts && node --import tsx ../tests/botSelfPlay.test.ts && node --import tsx ../tests/botLiveWiring.test.ts
scripts.electron:build-client: cd cobo && npx vite build --mode electron
scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:build-client && npx electron electron/main.js
scripts.electron:build: npm run electron:make-icon && npm run electron:build-client && npx electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.electron:build-mac: npm run electron:make-icon && npm run electron:build-client && npx electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never && mkdir -p "$HOME/Downloads/Lumo Mac" && cp dist-electron/*.dmg "$HOME/Downloads/Lumo Mac/"
